def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import defaultdict
    pos=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]: pos[g[i][j]].append((i,j))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for c,ps in pos.items():
        top=[p for p in ps if p[0]==0]
        (ti,tj),=top
        for i in range(ti,h): out[i][tj]=c
        if len(ps)==2:
            other=[p for p in ps if p!=(ti,tj)][0]
            oi,oj=other
            step=1 if tj>oj else -1
            for j in range(oj,tj+step,step): out[oi][j]=c
    return out
